speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any night sweats, fevers, or changes in your appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: In view of your age, significant unintentional weight loss, and constitutional symptoms (fatigue, malaise) without reported fever, night sweats, or appetite changes, the clinical picture is highly concerning for a malignancy. We need to proceed immediately with a workup to identify the underlying cause.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Serum_Lactate_Dehydrogenase
REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay, Abdomen_Pelvis_CT_With_Contrast
REQUEST IMAGES: Please return the results of the Chest X-Ray and CT scan.
